cards.summary: Jason Deck introduction and family history

cards.text: Jason introduces himself and his running crew via voiceover before appearing on screen: "My name's Jason Deck, I live in Brooklyn, New York, and I run with Nice Jewish Runners."

On-camera, Jason sets up his family's origin story: "My great-grandparents are Holocaust survivors. I had family that came over in the mass migrations in the late 1800s early 1900s through Ellis Island"

children.notes: Trim 4 seconds of the overhead drone shot

cards.summary: Jason jogging with vintage light flare

cards.text: Open on the top-down overhead drone shot of Jason jogging through the streets, treated with a high-contrast black-and-white grade, subtle film grain, and an overlaid vintage street light flare with projector audio. Cut after 4 seconds to the on-camera interview in full color.
An old-fashioned, contemplative piano track fades in gently under the ambient city noise.

beats.name: Story Beat 2: The Grandfather's New York Legacy

cards.notes: Trim 22 seconds of Jason bridging his family's past to New York athletics and Maccabi

cards.text: Jason bridges his family's past to New York athletics: "Yeah, so being a Jewish American is like a story of old world to new world. And for me, the best example I have of it is my grandfather came to the US in the late 40s from Israel. He moved to Washington Heights and played for Maccabi, New York."

Hold on Jason's on-camera interview to maintain the 75% interview focus, allowing his personal delivery and connection to carry the weight of the story. Cut away briefly for 3 seconds to black-and-white stylized footage of running shoes striking the pavement before returning to his face.
Piano theme swells slightly, maintaining an earnest, reflective tone.

cards.notes: Trim to 13s of Jason discussing wearing the jersey and showing pictures to his grandfather

cards.text: Jason speaks about the continuity across generations: "And being able to kind of wear a jersey while doing these very public events is something that both hits home for me, but also, yeah, I get to show my grandfather's pictures of me running in a thing that probably says, like, nice Jewish runners."

cards.notes: Trim 4 seconds of the Star of David logo close-up

cards.text: Return to Jason on camera as he reflects on his own journey. Cut away for 4 seconds to an archival-graded black-and-white close-up of the Star of David logo on his running gear to visually reinforce his connection to heritage.
Piano continues underneath, providing steady emotional momentum.

beats.name: Story Beat 4: Identity & Running with Pride

cards.notes: Trim to 10s of Jason concluding on the American Jewish story and pride

cards.text: Jason delivers his concluding line: "It's the American Jewish story, and I think that's like something I get to Be proud of and also be proud of running with a club that like exemplifies that"

cards.notes: Trim 4 seconds of Jason on the track breaking into a warm smile

cards.text: Start on Jason concluding his thought on camera. Transition to a final 4-second black-and-white archival shot of Jason on the track breaking into a warm smile, fading out naturally on the smile.
The piano piece lands on a resolved final chord and fades with room tone.
